title: Fix City Lod Vector Tile Quadrant Edges
description: At city LOD, vector tiles show visible quadrant/tile edges. Enable land backdrop fill at city and finer LOD bands to hide tile seams.
summary: Light-cyan grid was `region_stroke` (secondary/teal) boundary and teal waterway segments clipped to MVT tile bbox edges — visible on water/park surfaces, nearly invisible on dark land. Extended seam culling: boundary/geolines/waterway drop segments touching any tile edge (`EitherEndpoint`); roads keep `BothEndpoints`. Polygon fills skip ring edges lying on tile bbox to remove teal AA fringe on water. WASM rebuilt.
